releaseNotes:
Release v0.15.0

New Features:
- Path root aliases: define named directories in Settings and reference them as @name/ in expression fields, so graphs move between machines without rewriting absolute paths (PS-215)
- Built-in @lib path root, a Save to Path Root entry in the File menu, and Save to Library on mod+alt+s (PS-215)
- Expression autocomplete completes the contents of a path root, one level at a time (PS-215)
- Subgraph navigation and cross-graph search resolve path roots (PS-215)

Bug Fixes:
- Toast notifications that were silently discarded are now shown (PS-216)
- Exposed parameters load for a subgraph whose path is set by expression, and refresh when a path root is repointed (PS-217)
- Autocomplete reports when a folder is too large to list instead of appearing complete; folders are listed before files (PS-218)
- Expression autocomplete positions correctly on a panned or zoomed canvas
- Settings save failures are surfaced instead of swallowed
- Invalid path root names are rejected when settings are saved rather than at deploy time
- Random Number no longer panics when min equals max on the Float path (PS-212)

Improvements:
- Workspace lints are enforced in every crate (PS-211)
- macOS build signing
- Consolidated dependency updates
- Documentation corrections, emoji removed from UI strings, and accessibility improvements to the expression autocomplete
